The '''Mankvim-814 light interceptor''',<ref name="SWCL" /> also known as the '''Techno Union Fighter''',<ref name="WIRED" /> was an [[interceptor]] manufactured by the [[Techno Union]] during the era of the [[Clone Wars]]. The [[Grand Hall of the Traders' Guild]] in [[Pau City]] on the [[planet]] [[Utapau]] was converted by the guild into a factory to construct Mankvim-814s prior to the [[Battle of Utapau]].<ref name="SWCL" />

==Characteristics==
The Mankvim-814 was a compact, single-[[pilot]] [[interceptor]] [[starfighter]] designed by the [[Techno Union]] and manufactured by [[Feethan Ottraw Scalable Assemblies]]<ref name="Complete New" /> to act as a small versatile fighter craft for the defense of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] footholds<ref name="Complete Vehicles 2018">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2018)]]</ref> and specifically the [[planet]] [[Utapau]].<ref name="Complete New" /> Because of this versatile role, and its ability to be constructed from whatever materials happened to be present on a world, the Mankvim was extremely lightweight. It was constructed from a thin frame that made it very vulnerable to enemy fire, but fast in combat,<ref name="Complete Vehicles 2018" /> and its interior systems were designed to be as simplistic as possible: it was little more than a central [[reactor]] directly connected to and powering the single [[Ion engine|ion drive]] engine,<ref name="Complete New" /> which, along with maneuvering fans on the wings, moved the starfighter around. The Makvim did not have a [[hyperdrive]], as it was focused on local area defense.<ref name="Complete Vehicles 2018" />

The Makvim-814 was armed with twin rapid-fire [[laser cannon]]s<ref name="Complete Vehicles 2018" /> mounted on the front of the ship, next to the forward [[sensor]] and [[scanner]] array. To survive encounters with heavier armed starfighters, it was equipped with powerful [[deflector shield]]s and maneuvering side thrusters next to the main drive, which allowed it to perform complex roll and yaw adjustments to its flight path. A padding of [[repulsorlift]]s on the wings, which added aerodynamic lift in subsonic [[atmosphere|atmospheric]] flights, and a [[magnet]]ized thrust-vectoring rudder attached to the ion drive completed the ship's maneuvering systems,<ref name="Complete New" /> and allowed it to effectively engage more advanced craft, compensating for its lack of armor and heavier weaponry.<ref name="Complete Vehicles 2018" />

==History==
The Mankvim-418 light interceptor was designed by the Techno Union sometime prior to the [[Battle of Utapau]].<ref name="Complete Vehicles 2018" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This is the Techno Union Fighter. The first time we see this is in ''Revenge of the Sith''. It has a very ''Flash Gordon''-esque feel to it and George was very inspired by ''Flash Gordon'' and I think ''Star Wars'' itself is sort of inspired by ''Flash Gordon'' and George's love for it. And that can be seen in ships like the Techno Union Fighter|Amy Beth Christenson|<ref name="WIRED" />}}
The Mankvim-814 interceptor,<ref name="SWCL" /> also known as the Techno Union Fighter, first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. It was inspired by Flash Gordon designs.<ref name="WIRED" />
